name: swingle
description: Share the load: dispatch implementation and review work across coding-agent CLIs as providers (codex/opencode/agy/grok/pi/claude/omp), locally, through provider gotcha notes, contracts, and an auditable ledger — no proxy, no key custody.

interface.shortDescription: Dispatch work across coding-agent CLIs through provider gotcha notes, locally
interface.longDescription: Swingle is a local LLM-controlled dispatcher: it executes implementation plans and one-off jobs through external-CLI subagents (codex, opencode, agy, grok, pi, claude, omp) using advisory model preferences, provider gotcha notes, reusable contracts, and an auditable ledger. It spawns processes locally against credentials you already hold — no proxy, no key custody.
